morphreborn.message.unlock_biomass: Can't morph yet: unlock biomass first (Wither + Regeneration at once)
morphreborn.message.buy_morph_ability: Can't morph yet: buy the Morph Ability (%s or /morph upgrades)
morphreborn.message.classic_mode: This server plays Classic Mode: no biomass or upgrades.
morphreborn.settings.biomassBar.tooltip: Survival Mode servers: the biomass bar in the bottom left corner.
morphreborn.settings.frenzyMeter.tooltip: Servers with Devouring Frenzy: its meter in the bottom left corner. When It Changes also shows it while your frenzy is charged or running.
morphreborn.settings.title: RE:Morph Settings
morphreborn.settings.acquisition.tooltip:
Morph: black tendrils pull a defeated mob into the player who gains it.
Plain: dark particle trails instead, as players without the mod see it.

Only changes what you see. You still gain morphs, and other players are not affected.
morphreborn.settings.transition.tooltip:
Morph: the body turns black and melts into the new shape.
Plain: the body shrinks into dark smoke and the new one grows back, as players without the mod see it.

Only changes what you see. Transforming works the same, and other players are not affected.
morphreborn.settings.unlockToasts.toolti: Show a toast when you gain a new morph.
morphreborn.settings.nameTags.tooltip: Show name tags above morphed players (when the server shows them).
morphreborn.settings.mouse.tooltip: While the selector is open: the wheel scrolls, left click picks, right click closes, middle click favorites.
morphreborn.settings.invertScroll.toolti: Flip the mouse wheel direction in the selector.
morphreborn.settings.updateCheck.tooltip: Each time you join a server or a world, say in chat if a newer RE:Morph release is out, and if the server runs an older RE:Morph than this mod. GitHub's public release page is asked at game start and every 6 hours; nothing else is sent.
morphreborn.update.available: RE:Morph %s is out; your client mod is %s.
morphreborn.update.serverOlder: This server runs RE:Morph %1$s; your client mod is %2$s. Everything works, but features added after %1$s aren't on this server.
morphreborn.update.serverOlderUnknown: This server runs a RE:Morph from before 6.6.0; your client mod is %s. Everything works, but newer features aren't on this server.
morphreborn.update.serverIncompatible: This server runs RE:Morph %1$s, too old for your client mod (%2$s): here you play as a player without the mod.
morphreborn.settings.doll.open.tooltip: A live miniature of yourself on screen: your morph, its animations and transformations, and your vehicle.
morphreborn.settings.doll.title: Paper Doll
morphreborn.settings.doll.tooltip: Show the paper doll. The Show/Hide Paper Doll key (Controls, unbound at first) flips this too. Off: hidden until you press the key.
morphreborn.settings.dollShow.tooltip:
Always: whenever the doll is on.
While Morphed: only while you are a morph or transforming.
While Active: only in the situations chosen under "While Active, Show When...", and for a moment after.
morphreborn.settings.dollCorner.tooltip: The screen corner the doll sits in.
morphreborn.settings.dollSize.tooltip: How big the doll is, in pixels on your screen; the GUI scale doesn't change it. A player fills the box; smaller morphs are drawn smaller, and only something bigger than a player is shrunk to fit.
morphreborn.settings.dollX.tooltip: Distance from the left or right edge of the screen, in pixels.
morphreborn.settings.dollY.tooltip: Distance from the top or bottom edge of the screen, in pixels.
morphreborn.settings.dollAngle.tooltip: Which way the doll faces. 0 looks straight at you.
morphreborn.settings.dollHead.tooltip:
How the head of your doll moves, whatever you are morphed into.
Follows You: turns and looks up and down as yours does.
Turns Only: turns, but stays level.
Looks Up/Down Only: faces forward, looks up and down.
Straight: always faces forward, level.
Looks at You: always looks out of the screen at you.
morphreborn.settings.dollLight.tooltip:
Bright: always fully lit.
Like the World: as dark or light as where you stand.
morphreborn.settings.dollVehicle.tooltip: While riding, show the boat, minecart or mount with everyone on it.
morphreborn.settings.dollInMenus.tooltip: Keep showing the doll while a menu is open: your inventory, chests, chat, the pause menu, other mods' screens. It's drawn on top of the menu.
morphreborn.settings.dollHideThirdPerson: Hide the doll in third-person view, where you can see yourself anyway.
morphreborn.settings.dollHideDebug.toolt: Hide the doll while the F3 debug screen is open.
morphreborn.settings.dollOpacity.tooltip: How solid the doll is. Lower it to see the game through the doll.
morphreborn.message.buy_morph_ability_no: Can't morph yet: buy the Morph Ability (Biomass button in the favourites wheel, or /morph upgrades)
morphreborn.settings.dollLinger.tooltip: While Active: how long the doll stays after the last chosen situation ends.
morphreborn.settings.dollTilt.tooltip: How far you see the doll from above. Negative values look up at it from below.
morphreborn.settings.dollScale.tooltip:
True Size: a player fills the box; smaller morphs are drawn smaller, and only bigger ones shrink to fit.
Fill the Box: every form is drawn as big as fits.
morphreborn.settings.dollVignette.toolti: A soft dark haze around the doll that fades out from its edges, so it stands out from the world behind it. Slide right to spread it further; all the way left turns it off.
morphreborn.settings.dollOutlineStrength: How dark the vignette is right next to the doll.
morphreborn.settings.dollLockElytra.tool: Keep the doll's head level while you glide with an elytra.
morphreborn.settings.dollLockSpin.toolti: Keep the doll's head level while you spin with a riptide trident.
morphreborn.settings.dollHideMusic.toolt: Hide the doll while the "now playing" music toast is showing.
morphreborn.settings.dollWhen.walking.to: Show the doll while you walk on the ground.
Show the doll while you crouch.
Show the doll while you sprint.
morphreborn.settings.dollWhen.airborne.t: Show the doll while you are in the air: jumping, falling, a chicken gliding.
morphreborn.settings.dollWhen.elytra.too: Show the doll while you glide with an elytra.
morphreborn.settings.dollWhen.swimming.t: Show the doll while you swim.
morphreborn.settings.dollWhen.flying.too: Show the doll while you fly: as a flying morph, or in creative.
morphreborn.settings.dollWhen.climbing.t: Show the doll while you climb a ladder or vines, or a wall as a spider.
morphreborn.settings.dollWhen.riding.too: Show the doll while you ride a vehicle or a mount.
morphreborn.settings.dollWhen.blocking.t: Show the doll while you block with a shield.
morphreborn.settings.dollWhen.using_item: Show the doll while you use an item: eating, drawing a bow, drinking.
morphreborn.settings.dollWhen.swinging.t: Show the doll while you swing your arm (or the morph's attack).
morphreborn.settings.dollWhen.hurt.toolt: Show the doll when you get hurt.
morphreborn.settings.dollWhen.on_fire.to: Show the doll while you burn, a zombie morph in the sun included.
morphreborn.settings.dollWhen.powder_sno: Show the doll while you are in powder snow.
morphreborn.settings.dollWhen.sleeping.t: Show the doll while you sleep in a bed.
morphreborn.settings.dollWhen.transformi: Show the doll while you morph into something else.
morphreborn.settings.dollWhen.ability.to: Show the doll for a moment when you press the morph ability key.
morphreborn.settings.absorbMorph.tooltip:
What you see when someone gains a new morph.
Black Tendrils: the original absorb, the mob pulled in by black tendrils.
Red Tendrils: the same, tinted dark red.
Red Wisps: short red streams from the body into the player; the mob isn't taken.
Plain: the particles players without the mod see.
Off: nothing.

Only changes what you see.
morphreborn.settings.absorbBiomass.toolt:
Survival Mode: what you see when a kill only gives biomass.
Black Tendrils: the original absorb, the mob pulled in by black tendrils.
Red Tendrils: the same, tinted dark red.
Red Wisps: short red streams from the body into the player; the mob isn't taken.
Plain: the particles players without the mod see.
Off: nothing.

Only changes what you see.
